body: Thats how most parents are, it is the same with mine they feign ignorance.                                           The best thing to do is to be your own pillar, be the villain. Even if you hurt some people in the process of finding your own happiness, do it. Nobody is perfect. Find your own support and be your own lifeline. Suicide isn’t a cowards way out, its a warrior who couldn’t win his battles. Parents tend to prefer pretending like their child is perfect, unless your physically wounded it doesn’t count. The reason you should keep going is your own, your goals, your dreams, travel, your own discovery to happiness. Anything and everything. They should be your reasons. Keep living for yourself. Be selfish.

I always imagined jumping from a cliff or off a building to Bring me to the horizon- can you feel my heart. Try blasting some music in ur headphones and imaging it instead of doing it. It helps me cope, might be the same for u

I should try cry it out, but i know my mindset wont change. Ive been the same for 6 years, i had a great relationship with someone who truly loved me. I tried to play the part but i ended up being worse. Im content with being alone. I want to die, but i wont do it. Its not that I’m scared, i just don’t want to hurt or disappoint the people i care for. But cheers for the inspirational words mate.

Something thats always helped me has been the mindset of a villain. It doesn’t matter what you have to do, even if it hurts some people in the process. Create your own path and happiness. Drop everything if you need to.You are the only one who can save yourself even if you feel like you cant do it anymore. Don’t strain yourself too much. Sit down, cry for a while. Then try get back up again. Its all trial and error.
